q: Which Python linter infers real values and is more thorough but slower?
why: Pylint's own docs say inference makes it slower but finds more issues in untyped code.

q: Flake8 combines which two older tools?
why: Pyflakes finds likely bugs (F codes) and pycodestyle checks style (E and W codes).

q: You want one fast tool that both lints and formats JavaScript with little setup.
why: Biome's check command runs the formatter and linter in one pass.

q: ShellCheck is best known for catching …
o: quoting mistakes such as an unquoted variable
why: An unquoted variable splits on spaces, which can break or misdirect a command.

q: Which is NOT one of the four questions for choosing a linter?
o: What does the team already use?
Which has the most GitHub stars?
why: The chapter asks about the team, one tool or two, speed and plugins.

q: Ruff reuses many Flake8 codes, which makes moving from Flake8 to Ruff easy.
why: Fact: Ruff covers many of the same pyflakes and pycodestyle codes.
